patient._comment: 'patient' is info about the patient: personal, clinical, vitals are shown on the patient card during the game; diagnosis is used for potential 'patient review' card.

clinical.quoteLong: I've got this crushing pressure on my chest like an elephant sitting on me, going down my left arm and into my jaw. I'm sweating buckets and feel like I might throw up. Started half an hour ago.
clinical.presentationShort: 61yo M ? 30 minutes crushing substernal pressure radiating to left arm and jaw, with diaphoresis, nausea, and ongoing 8/10 pain.
clinical.presentationLong: 61-year-old male with thirty minutes of ongoing crushing central chest pressure radiating to his left arm and jaw. He is drenched in sweat, nauseated, and rates the pain 8/10.

diagnosis.disposition: Resus → immediate ECG, aspirin, activate cath lab, cardiology; door-to-balloon clock is running.
diagnosis.why: Classic MI: pressure to the arm/jaw, diaphoretic, nauseated. ECG immediately; aspirin + cath lab. Time is muscle.
diagnosis.redFlag: Crushing chest pressure radiating to arm/jaw + diaphoresis = MI; ECG in the first minutes.

answer._comment: 'answer' is answer for the game scoring.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.pose: clutching a fist to the center of his chest
signs: fist clenched to the center of the chest
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character, 3/4 front view, centered, square 1:1. Match the exact painterly style, brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting, and palette of the attached reference image. Subject: a hispanic 61-year-old man, sweaty and ashen, seated on a blue padded clinic chair. Pose: a clenched fist pressed to the center of his chest. Expression: frightened and in pain. Clearly visible: a fist clenched over the chest and a sweaty, gray face. No text, no logos.
